candidates.change_summary: Replace the conditional guard to use strict greater-than so deposits equal to MinDeposit are rejected (changes when caller sends exactly MinDeposit).
Remove the arithmetic overflow check require, allowing deposits to update balances without the defensive require (could change balances on overflow in edge cases).

Move the TransferLog.AddMessage call before updating balances so the logged value is unchanged but balances update occurs after logging (observable balances differ during reentrancy or external observer patterns).
Change balances update to set instead of add, so each deposit overwrites previous balance (clears prior funds recorded).
Negate the condition so deposits are processed only when msg.value is less than MinDeposit (inverts eligibility).
